# Wistia

Wistia is a video marketing platform for hosting and managing media, channels, webinars, audience analytics, and account content.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/wistia/.

## Actions

- **Create Folder**: Create a Wistia folder for organizing media, optionally make it public, and optionally set the specified email as its owner.
- **Delete Folder**: Delete a Wistia folder by hashed ID.
- **Delete Media**: Delete one Wistia media item by hashed ID.
- **Get Analytics Summary** (read-only): Return account-wide or single-media Wistia performance metrics for an inclusive start date and exclusive end date.
- **Get Media** (read-only): Return detailed metadata, assets, folder placement, tags, and processing state for one Wistia media item.
- **Import Media from URL**: Start importing a publicly reachable media URL into Wistia, optionally into a folder.
- **Search Content** (read-only): Search the connected Wistia account for media, folders, subfolders, channels, and channel episodes by text and optional filters.
- **Set Media Archived State**: Archive one or more media items, or restore archived media into a destination folder, and wait for Wistia's background job to finish.
- **Update Folder**: Update a Wistia folder's name, description, public visibility, or anonymous transfer settings.
- **Update Media**: Update a Wistia media item's name, description, tags, or still image reference.
